articles.title: Polymarket code “SILIVE” unlocks $25 referral promo for Packers-Rams on Thanksgiving Eve
articles.summary: Polymarket's running a $25 referral promo tied to the Packers-Rams matchup on Thanksgiving Eve, and they're using the code SILIVE to gate access. It's a straightforward play to juice volume on a high-profile NFL game when casual bettors are already in a holiday gambling mood.

articles.title: Most Polymarket users lost money betting on the U.S. midterms, report finds
articles.summary: Most Polymarket traders got their midterms forecast spectacularly wrong, with the majority walking away net negative on their wagers. It's a stark reminder that prediction markets attract plenty of confident amateurs who mistake conviction for accuracy.

articles.title: Polymarket Turns GPU Price Bets into a Compute Forward Curve
articles.summary: Polymarket is letting traders bet on GPU prices in a way that essentially creates a forward curve for compute costs, turning sporadic price movements into a structured market signal. That's actually useful because it gives AI labs and crypto miners real-time price discovery for their biggest operational expense instead of relying on vendor quotes and spot market noise.

articles.title: Polymarket expands AI compute markets as US rivals face delays
articles.summary: Polymarket is launching prediction markets for AI compute pricing and availability, betting that traders want to speculate on GPU scarcity and cloud infrastructure costs while US competitors drag their feet. This matters because compute costs directly drive AI company valuations and capex spending, so markets that price these inputs give traders a real edge on predicting everything from Nvidia's earnings to which labs actually have the juice to train frontier models.

articles.title: Where Every League Stands on Kalshi, Polymarket
articles.summary: Sports leagues are finally taking public stances on whether they'll allow Kalshi and Polymarket to operate prediction markets on their games. If major leagues crack down, it chops off a significant revenue stream and user base for platforms that have built their entire pitch around real-money sports betting.

articles.title: Young New Yorkers are losing money on prediction markets. That's not a reason to ban them.
articles.summary: Young New Yorkers are dumping money into prediction markets and predictably getting wrecked, sparking the usual regulatory hand-wringing from people who think banning things solves problems. The real story is whether regulators actually listen to the "let people lose their own money" argument, or if we're headed for another round of restrictions that'll just push the action offshore.

articles.title: Crypto.com’s Prediction Market Spinoff Feels Liquidity Crunch
articles.summary: Crypto.com spun off its prediction market platform and is now getting absolutely starved for liquidity, which is basically death for a betting venue where nobody wants to trade. When your order book is thinner than a startup's runway, you're watching the prediction market equivalent of a ghost town, and that's exactly what happens when volume dries up.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.summary: OpenAI is now expected to go public sometime later in 2027 instead of earlier in the year, according to prediction market data. If true, it delays when early bettors can cash out their positions and shifts the timeline for one of tech's most anticipated IPOs by several months.

articles.title: CME Group Eyes Growth as Prediction Markets Gain Strong Momentum
articles.summary: CME Group is positioning itself to capitalize on prediction markets as they transition from niche curiosity to mainstream financial infrastructure. If the largest derivatives exchange in the world is moving aggressively into this space, regulatory legitimacy and institutional liquidity are coming whether the purists like it or not.

articles.title: Gold drops below $3,500; prediction markets price moderate year-end targets (XAUUSD:CUR:Commodity)
articles.summary: Gold just took a tumble below $3,500 an ounce, forcing traders to recalibrate their year-end price expectations downward. For prediction market players, this matters because a commodity this volatile tends to reshape near-term settlement odds faster than most assets, which means the sharp movers among you probably just got an edge on slow-reacting crowd positions.

articles.title: Van Hollen Calls Senate Democratic Leader Race 'Wide Open' as Prediction Markets Favor Schumer
articles.summary: Senate Democrats are picking their next leader, and Van Hollen says it's anyone's game despite prediction markets heavily favoring Schumer to keep the role. The gap between political rhetoric and market odds creates an arbitrage opportunity if Van Hollen knows something the smart money doesn't.

articles.title: Simon Denny on Prediction Markets, Speculation, and the Future of Truth
articles.summary: Simon Denny is making a case that prediction markets aren't just gambling tools, they're infrastructure for how we establish what's actually true in a world drowning in noise and incentive misalignment. If he's right, that reframes the entire industry from "betting app" to "epistemic utility," which changes how regulators, institutions, and smart money should be thinking about market design and participation.
